name: Typography Studio
original_description: Build and refine typefaces from a brief: control glyphs, optical corrections, spacing, kerning, weights, italics, variable families and exports. Review actual rendered words and responsive hierarchy, with clear attribution and evidence. Includes optional local proofing scripts and Latin English/Spanish exercises. Requires image inspection for visual conclusions and suitable font-editing tools for source changes. Technical checks do not certify aesthetics, reading speed or untested platforms.
